name: Duck-In Diner / Pool Deck Spit-Roasted Chicken & Lamb Shawarma Pita (Disney Magic)
whyItWorks: Disney Magic's signature poolside exclusive: thinly shaved spit-roasted chicken shawarma wrapped in a warm soft white pita.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken Shawarma in a warm pita with meat only (or a light dab of garlic-free tahini/yogurt)—hold the raw red onions, tomatoes, lettuce, and pickles.
watchOuts: Hold raw onions, tomatoes, and pickles inside the pita
Choose lean chicken shawarma over fattier lamb during flares
